description:
Returns the deployment configuration defined by the specified revision.
Only the 50 most recent revisions per deployment retain their configuration; older revisions return 404 even while they still appear in the revision history.
The deployment's currently active revision is always available, regardless of age.

404.description: Deployment not found, or revision not found / no longer retained

summary: Get the full configuration of a specific revision

RevisionDetailResponse.description: Deployment configuration captured for one retained revision.

args.description: Arguments passed to the container command.

autoscaling.description: Autoscaling configuration captured for this revision.

capacity_type.description: Capacity behavior for replicas above reserved capacity.

command.description: Entrypoint command run by the container.

cpu.description: CPU cores allocated to each replica.

created_at.description: Time when this revision was created.

environment_variables.description: Environment variables configured on this revision.

gpu_count.description: Number of GPUs allocated to each replica.

gpu_type.description: GPU hardware type configured for this revision.

health_check_path.description: HTTP path used for health checks.

image.description: Container image used by this revision.

max_replicas.description: Maximum number of replicas configured for this revision.

memory.description: Memory allocated to each replica in GiB.

min_replicas.description: Minimum number of replicas configured for this revision.

object.description: The object type, which is always `revision`.

port.description: Container port exposed by this revision.

protocol.description: Network protocol served by the deployment revision.

storage.description: Ephemeral storage allocated to each replica.

termination_grace_period_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for graceful shutdown before forcefully terminating a replica.

volumes.description: Volume mounts attached to this revision.

HTTPAutoscalingConfig.description: Autoscaling config for HTTPTotalRequests and HTTPAvgRequestDuration metrics

metric.description: Metric must be HTTPTotalRequests or HTTPAvgRequestDuration

target.description: Target is the threshold value. Default: 100 for HTTPTotalRequests, 500 (ms) for HTTPAvgRequestDuration

time_interval_minutes.description: TimeIntervalMinutes is the rate window in minutes. Default: 10

model.description: Model overrides the model name for queue status lookup. Defaults to the deployment app name

target.description: Target is the threshold value. Default: 1.01

custom_metric_name.description: CustomMetricName is the Prometheus metric name. Must match [a-zA-Z_:][a-zA-Z0-9_:]*

target.description: Target is the threshold value. Default: 500

name.description: Name is the environment variable name (e.g., "DATABASE_URL"). Must start with a letter or underscore, followed by letters, numbers, or underscores

value.description: Value is the plain text value for the environment variable. Use this for non-sensitive values. Either Value or ValueFromSecret must be set, but not both

value_from_secret.description: ValueFromSecret references a secret by name or ID to use as the value. Use this for sensitive values like API keys or passwords. Either Value or ValueFromSecret must be set, but not both

mount_path.description: MountPath is the path in the container where the volume mounts (e.g., "/data").

name.description: Name is the name of the volume to mount. Must reference an existing volume by name or ID

version.description: Version is the volume version to mount. On create, defaults to the latest version. On update, defaults to the currently mounted version.
